question: Ingest the loading-dock clip for search, then find up to three forklift instances in it.
ground_truth: A combined ingest-and-search request activates the search skill for the search phase only. Ingestion is handled by vss-manage-video-io-storage (which registers via `vss vios add`; the deployment's notification config owns the fan-out); the search skill performs archive retrieval only once the source is available and never ingests, switches sources, or runs an unrestricted search.
expected_behavior: The agent loads vss-search-archive for the retrieval phase and preserves the requested source and visual constraints.

For the ingestion phase the agent routes to vss-manage-video-io-storage rather than ingesting from inside the search skill; it does not combine a UI/Agent completion path with a second VIOS registration for the same source.
The agent uses the supported search interface for the selected deployment and does not expose credentials, substitute another source, or mutate a backend directly.

question: Find up to three clips in dock_cam where a forklift crosses in front of a worker.
ground_truth: The agent resolves dock_cam, performs bounded archive retrieval for the requested forklift-and-worker action, and reports the returned candidates as retrieval evidence.
expected_behavior: The agent loads vss-search-archive without requiring the user to name the skill.
The agent resolves dock_cam before search and preserves the action and three-result limit.
The agent does not claim that similarity alone visually confirms the event.

question: Both archive-search hits were shown and both CLI critic results are unverified. Yes, verify the two results now.
ground_truth: Because every previously displayed hit is unverified, the agent treats the message as post-results confirmation and delegates those exact hits to vss-ask-video without rerunning retrieval.
expected_behavior: The agent loads vss-search-archive and uses the exact previously displayed sources and intervals.
The agent confirms the complete displayed set contains no confirmed or rejected hit, invokes vss-ask-video with at most three calls concurrently, and does not rerun search.
The agent uses screenshot inspection only after a technical ask-video failure.

question: Search warehouse-ladder for someone climbing a ladder and verify whatever you find.
ground_truth: The agent performs archive retrieval, reports the CLI critic verdict for every candidate, and asks about delegated verification only when every displayed hit remains unverified.
expected_behavior: The agent loads vss-search-archive and searches the exact warehouse-ladder source.
The agent displays nonempty retrieval results with confirmed, rejected, or unverified critic states before any follow-up question.
The agent asks about fallback verification only if the complete nonempty result set is unverified and does not inspect screenshots or call vss-ask-video in the same turn.

question: The three search hits are shown: one is confirmed and two are unverified. Should you verify the other two?
ground_truth: The agent does not offer or invoke delegated ask-video verification because at least one result already has a usable CLI critic verdict.
expected_behavior: The agent recognizes that the displayed result set is partially verified.
The agent does not invoke vss-ask-video for any hit and does not inspect screenshots.
The agent explains that fallback delegation is reserved for result sets in which every hit is unverified.

question: Search the airport video for forklifts.
ground_truth: The agent lists registered sources and, when no airport source exists, reports the missing source and asks for clarification or explicit ingestion instead of substituting another video.
expected_behavior: The agent loads vss-search-archive and checks registered sources before search.
The agent does not run unrestricted retrieval when the requested source is absent.
The agent does not leak secrets or ingest media without authorization.

question: Search the live camera stream dock_cam_live for a person entering the restricted zone.
ground_truth: The agent resolves the live stream, runs archive retrieval scoped to it with the rtsp source type, and does not conflate live-stream documents with the uploads anchor.
expected_behavior: The agent loads vss-search-archive and resolves dock_cam_live to its registered live-stream identity before search.
The agent selects --source-type rtsp and scopes retrieval to the resolved live-stream identifier.
The agent does not select the upload partition or a date-stamped anchor index, does not treat an empty uploads anchor as a live-stream failure, and does not poll a search index directly.

question: This deployment has both uploaded clips and a live camera gate_cam. Find forklifts only in the live camera feed.
ground_truth: The agent restricts retrieval to the live camera by selecting the rtsp source type and the resolved stream identity, so uploaded-file documents are excluded regardless of ingestion order.
expected_behavior: The agent loads vss-search-archive and resolves gate_cam to its live-stream identity.
The agent runs retrieval with --source-type rtsp scoped to that identity so uploaded-file hits are excluded.
The agent does not select the upload partition or a date-stamped anchor index and does not conflate the two source types.

question: In dock_cam, find up to three clips of a worker in a hard hat carrying a cone.
ground_truth: The agent decomposes the single sentence into a detectable property and an action, so it routes to fusion rather than defaulting to embed on the sentence's surface form.
expected_behavior: The agent loads vss-search-archive and resolves dock_cam before search.
The agent recognizes the embedded detectable property (hard hat) and routes to fusion, not embed, even though the request arrived as one sentence.
The agent keeps the action carrying a cone in the query and passes hard hat as the attribute, without extracting a generic noun or an object's own color as an attribute.

question: My last `vss search run embed` for forklifts in warehouse_sample returned exit 6 with three hits but `"persisted": false`. What should I report, and should I rerun?
ground_truth: Exit 6 is partial, not failure: the response carried usable hits but `"persisted": false`, so a later stage (persistence) failed. The agent reports the three hits once, discloses the persistence limitation, and does not rerun the search or discard the usable results.
expected_behavior: The agent recognizes exit 6 as a partial result that still carries usable `data`, and reads `search_messages` when present.
The agent reports the three hits once with their source, interval, score, media URL when present, and verification verdict, and states the persistence limitation.
The agent does not rerun the search, does not treat exit 6 as a hard failure, and does not broaden scope or fall back to raw REST.

question: Ingest the loading-dock camera feed into the search index so I can search it later.
ground_truth: A pure ingestion request routes to the source-management skill (vss-manage-video-io-storage), which registers via `vss vios add`, not to the search skill.
expected_behavior: The agent does not load or activate vss-search-archive for an ingestion-only request.
The agent routes source registration to vss-manage-video-io-storage or an equivalent source-management workflow.

question: Delete the warehouse-ladder source from the search deployment.
ground_truth: A pure deletion request routes to the source-management skill (vss-manage-video-io-storage), which deletes via `vss vios delete`, not to the search skill.
expected_behavior: The agent does not load or activate vss-search-archive for a deletion-only request.
The agent routes source deletion to vss-manage-video-io-storage or an equivalent source-management workflow.

question: Watch /workspace/input/forklift.mp4 and tell me whether the driver is wearing a helmet.
ground_truth: The agent answers the fresh visual question using a video-Q&A capability against the supplied local clip.
expected_behavior: The agent does not load or activate vss-search-archive.
The agent routes the local-video visual question to vss-ask-video or an equivalent video-Q&A workflow.

question: Summarize the full hour-long recording from loading_dock_2.
ground_truth: The agent uses the video summarization workflow to summarize the requested full recording.
expected_behavior: The agent does not load or activate vss-search-archive.
The agent routes the long-recording summary request to vss-summarize-video or an equivalent summarization workflow.
